subject: Greenlight - CAIQ evidence curation and traceability plan
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <security@greenlightpayments.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenlightpayments.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenlight - CAIQ evidence prelim review

Hi Markus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the CAIQ crosswalk you shared in the intake call last week — we ran a quick scan and have a couple of ask areas before we proceed to formal acceptance: 

- Can you provide a single evidence index (spreadsheet) that maps each CAIQ question to an artifact file name, owner, and a short trace comment?
- For controls that rely on runtime telemetry (e.g., logging, key use, network flows), we need sample log extracts and a short description of how you preserve context across your inference routing.
- A short statement on tenant isolation for Redwood Dedicated / Private would help clarify scope boundaries for our auditors.

Preferably we’d have the index and initial artifacts by EOD next week (2026-11-03). If any items are out of scope, please mark them clearly.

Also copying Tom in procurement to align on delivery mechanics for any signed NDA/portal access.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Security Manager, Greenlight Payments
[attachment: preliminary-scan.pdf (pdf)]

From: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
To: Emily Zhao <security@greenlightpayments.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenlightpayments.com>
Date: 2026-10-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenlight - CAIQ evidence prelim review

Emily — thanks for the clear asks. We’ll own the index and provide the artifacts you need. High-level plan below: 

1) Evidence index spreadsheet: we’ll deliver a single sheet that includes CAIQ question id, short answer, artifact filename, artifact owner (internal), and an evidence confidence flag (full / partial / compensating).
2) Runtime log samples: we will provide redacted log extracts and a README that explains collection time window, retention pointer, and how request IDs propagate through inference routing and KV cache layers.
3) Tenant isolation statement: Kimberly will draft a one-page attestation describing isolation across Hosted / Dedicated / Private and list the technical boundaries.

Owners and ETA:
- Evidence index & initial attachments: Markus (owner) — ETA 2026-10-31 EOD (shared Drive link + spreadsheet).
- Runtime logs + README: Marissa (owner) — ETA 2026-11-03.
- Tenant isolation attestation: Kimberly (owner) — draft by 2026-10-30.

We’ll mark anything we consider out of scope in the index. I’ve attached the first-pass index (CAIQ_Evidence_Index_v0.1.xlsx) — it’s lightweight but follows the columns above. Please confirm that format works.

Next steps: if format is ok I’ll push the Drive folder and a Jira ticket for artifact uploads.

—Markus Klein
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[attachment: CAIQ_Evidence_Index_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Emily Zhao <security@greenlightpayments.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.example.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, Tom Reed <tom.reed@greenlightpayments.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenlight - CAIQ evidence prelim review

Thanks Markus — format looks good to our audit team. A few clarifying requests to make the artifacts immediately usable for the CSA assessors: 

- When you flag something as "partial" or "compensating", please include a short remediation plan and an expected close date (even if tentative).
- For log samples, the assessors will want at least two representative traces that demonstrate request-id continuity across service boundaries. Can you confirm the anonymization approach you plan to use?
- Please map the following CAIQ control ids explicitly in the index: CCM-01 (Identity lifecycle), CCM-09 (Key management), and ISE-03 (Tenant segregation). 

If you can incorporate those into the spreadsheet and push the Drive link, we’ll kick off our internal pre-review and route to the external assessors.

—Emily
Security Manager, Greenlight Payments

Date: 2026-10-31T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenlight - CAIQ evidence prelim review

Emily — attaching the updated package and next-step commitments. Changes since the v0.1 index: 

- CAIQ_Evidence_Index_v1.xlsx (attached): includes explicit rows for CCM-01, CCM-09, ISE-03 with artifact names, owners, confidence, and planned remediation dates where applicable.
- CAIQ_Control_Mapping_v1.pdf (attached): a short narrative per major domain showing how our runtime telemetry, key management (HSM/KMS integration), and tenant isolation work across deployment modes.
- log-sample-instructions.txt (attached): describes redaction pattern (SHA256 of user ids, preserve request-id headers), and two sample traces we’ll upload to the Drive folder.

Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dGreenlightCAIQ
Jira: SEC-4821 created to track remaining artifacts and remediation tasks.

Owner assignments and deadlines (final):
- Evidence index and annotated artifacts: Markus (complete) — delivered 2026-10-31.
- Runtime log samples + README: Marissa — ETA 2026-11-03 (upload to Drive).
- Tenant isolation attestation: Kimberly — delivered 2026-10-31 (see mapping PDF).

Please confirm you received the Drive link and that the artifact format is acceptable for your assessors. If they need the logs in a different time window or a different anonymization approach, let us know and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to the pre-review feedback.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
